note: AI-generated sample photos used as placeholders in the website concepts. They will be replaced by real photos from club sessions, taken with consent, before launch.

photos.description: Four players mid-rally at the net in a bright Sporthalle. Near side: a grey-haired man (~70) and a teenage girl (~15). Far side: a woman (~40) and a man (~30). Everyone grinning; one reaches for a soft dink; the ball hangs over the net with slight motion blur. Camera low at court level near the sideline.
Paddle tap at the net after a point between a ~12-year-old boy and a woman in her 50s from opposite sides, both laughing.
A beginner's first rally: a host (woman ~45) coaching beside a beginner (man ~35) whose face lights up as he returns the ball.
The informal "family photo" after a session: about 16 people of all ages bunched on court, paddles raised, laughing, a couple of kids at the front. No banner, no text.

High-angle wide view from a gallery over a sports hall with three pickleball courts in play (portable nets), clearly showing the court lines and the kitchen zone; on the left court a player serves underhand; about 12 players of mixed ages.
The entrance of a German school sports hall (1970s concrete and glass) in late-afternoon light, with an A-frame sign showing only an arrow pictogram and a ball pictogram (no readable text).
The "Paddle Library": a plastic crate full of loan paddles in varied colours plus a few balls, on a bench at the side of the hall. No logos.
Close-up of indoor court shoes with non-marking gum soles on the hall floor beside a court line and a perforated ball. No faces.
Volunteers setting up a full-width portable pickleball net in the empty hall before a session; a younger man carries a mesh bag of balls.
Students at an evening session: hall at night, warm artificial light, energetic doubles on a lined pickleball court, a few people by the wall bars cheering.
A couple in their late 50s playing doubles against two students in their early 20s, everyone mid-laugh after a long rally. Not a "seniors" shot; it reads as equals.
A parent and a ~9-year-old child on the same side of the net; the child hits the ball, the parent cheers behind.
Women's doubles with a woman host at the net giving a tip, players of different ages, focused and friendly.
A man in his ~50s at courtside on a bench holding a pickleball paddle with curiosity, his tennis bag beside him.
Two pickleball paddles and a ball resting on the railing of a modern white steel arch pedestrian bridge over the wide Rhine at golden hour; the arch blurred behind. No people, or only distant ones.

"Dink & Drink" after a session: a wooden table on a café or clubhouse terrace in evening light, players of mixed ages chatting and laughing, paddles on the table, mostly alcohol-free drinks (apple spritzer, water) and a couple of beers.

Low angle along the net from beside the near post: two opponents, each just behind their kitchen line, trade a soft dink, the ball just over the net tape. Shallow depth of field; concentrated, half-smiling faces.
Seen from behind, a player in their 20s lunges wide for a low ball that has bounced, facing the net and the opponent, backlit by bright hall windows.
A 10-year-old girl with a gap-toothed grin, holding her paddle up beside her face, a little flushed from playing.
A 16-year-old boy, headphones around his neck, relaxed half-smile, paddle hanging from one hand.
A 24-year-old university student (woman), ponytail, sweatband on her wrist, bright laugh.
A 38-year-old father with a short beard, slightly sweaty, satisfied grin, paddle in both hands.
A 56-year-old woman, a former tennis player, confident and amused, paddle held like a racket.
A 74-year-old man with white hair, wiry and fit, cheeky smile, paddle tucked under his arm.
Outdoor doubles at golden hour with Black Forest hills behind. A woman in her 60s hits a forehand; her partner, a man in his 20s, moves to cover. Warm low sun, long shadows, rim light.
Macro: a solid paddle face meeting the perforated ball, a little motion blur, hall lights as bokeh. Hand and wrist partly in frame.
Overhead shot of eight hands holding paddles meeting in the centre for a team cheer, on the court floor with lines visible; varied skin tones and ages (a child's hand, an older hand).

An outdoor court beside terraced vineyards (Kaiserstuhl-like) in summer: a family game, a grandmother and her grandson against the parents, a grandfather and a girl watching from the stone wall, dappled late light.
